data.gender_notes: Amélie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Latin 'amare' meaning ‘to love’. In Christian tradition, Amélie is associated with devotion and dedication to God, as a name symbolizing the labor and toil God undergoes in the creation and sustenance of the world. The name Amélie carries the meaning “God's toil, labor of God” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Amélie usually hope their child will grow to embody god's toil, labor of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that embodies the love and devotion to God, a reminder of the divine labor and toil in our lives.

data.spiritual_significance: In Christian spirituality, Amélie is seen as a name that celebrates God's endless love and devotion towards humanity. By bearing this name, a person is called to reflect God's love and compassion in their daily lives, emulating the selfless labor and toil that God undergoes in the creation and sustenance of the world. The name Amélie, then, serves as a constant reminder of the spiritual bonds that connect us to the divine, inspiring us to live in a way that reflects God's love and devotion to us.
